name: Staff of Courage
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 195, Pathfinder Society Field Guide pg. 54
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 195, Pathfinder Society Field Guide pg. 54
Aura moderate enchantment CL 8th
Slot none; Price 20,800 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This sturdy-looking hickory staff is capped with a figurine of an angel or other benevolent spirit, wings and arms outstretched as if in welcome. This staff allows use of the following spells:
Bless (1 charge)
Remove fear (1 charge)
Prayer (2 charges)
Remove paralysis (2 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, bless, prayer, remove fear, remove paralysis; Cost 10,400 gp
